manifest.policy: Three original-model Can supported-placement diagnostics: one shared geometry on both development episodes, plus one admitted deeper source-1 backup. Forty-eight separate fixed-global-contact trials compare four apertures, three local reference speed caps and two physics step sizes on both development episodes. No object material changes. One full retimed Reachy physics attempt from successful BiGym source c795, with common gates and actuator audit; source 103d stays held out.

actuator_audit.meaning: Control replay equivalence; task and contact success remain separate recorded gates
